title: The role of body composition, irisin, and FABP4 levels in adolescent girls with polycystic ovary syndrome.
snippet: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between body composition parameters and serum irisin and FABP4 levels in adolescent girls with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
